  • Method Details

    • listTasks

      @GetMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<org.springframework.data.domain.Page<TaskResponse>> listTasks(@RequestParam(required=false) TaskStatus status, @RequestParam(required=false) String search, @PageableDefault(page=0,size=10,sort="createdAt",direction=DESC) org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Retrieves a paginated list of tasks with optional filtering.

      Example HTTP Request: GET /api/v1/tasks?status=TODO&search=clean&page=0&size=10&sort=dueDate,asc

      Parameters:
      status - optional query parameter to filter by task status
      search - optional query parameter to search text in titles
      pageable - page, size, and sort options (defaults to page 0, size 10, newest first)
      Returns:
      200 OK with paginated tasks

      Retrieves a single task by its database ID.

      Example HTTP Request: GET /api/v1/tasks/42

      Parameters:
      id - the primary key extracted from the URL path
      Returns:
      200 OK with the task response

    • createTask

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<TaskResponse> createTask(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid CreateTaskRequest request)
      Creates a new task.

      Beginner Tip - @Valid and Location Header:

      • @Valid instructs Spring to run validation constraints (e.g. @NotBlank) on CreateTaskRequest before invoking this method.
      • ServletUriComponentsBuilder creates a standard REST Location header (e.g. Location: /api/v1/tasks/42) indicating where the newly created resource lives.
      • Returns HTTP 201 Created instead of 200 OK.

      Parameters:
      request - validated JSON body
      Returns:
      201 Created with Location header and task body

    • updateTask

      @PutMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN') or @taskSecurity.isTaskOwner(#id, authentication.name)") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<TaskResponse> updateTask(@PathVariable Long id, @Valid @RequestBody @Valid UpdateTaskRequest request)
      Updates an existing task.

      Beginner Tip - @PreAuthorize: Uses Spring Expression Language (SpEL) to ensure only administrators OR the user who owns this specific task can update it.

      Parameters:
      id - task ID from path
      request - validated update payload
      Returns:
      200 OK with the updated task

    • deleteTask
